fit._doc: Travel & Map Formula G (rule 18): fit = f_e f_T f_R f_D. elem_floor e_floor, elem_full_share s_full (variant 20), fall the climate fall-off past the tolerance, density_need_by_rarity D_need by rarity index (0 unused), growth_max g_max, plant_floor, labels (each band includes its lower bound). Per herb: temp_ideal, temp_tol, rain_ideal, rain_tol on the 0-100 climate indexes (world_map.json climate_index). All are first guesses except the two GDD examples.

equivalent._doc: Item Database Formula B (user decision 2026-11-20): a herb of age a counts as E(x) mature herbs of its type, x = a / mature_years: E = x to maturity, 1 + s (x - 1) to the knee x_k, then E_k 2^((x - x_k) / d), with x_k,eff = max(x_k, K_y / mature_years) and d_eff = max(d, D_y / mature_years) (K_y 30, D_y 10 years; 2026-11-21). Herb value = base_value x E; recipes count equivalents.
